title: Chicken and Egg Rice Bowl
summary: Chicken thigh and onion simmered in a sweet soy broth, then finished with softly set egg and spooned over rice. A one-pan bowl my family asks for every week.

creator.bio: Sample creator. Simple Japanese home meals: rice bowls, noodles and quick glazes.

ingredients.name: egg
ingredients.notes: just break the yolks; streaks of white are fine

steps.instruction: Cut the chicken into bite-size pieces and slice the onion.
success_cues: Chicken pieces are roughly the same size
warnings: Sharp knife: curl your fingertips under and keep the board steady on a damp towel.
Raw chicken: wash hands, board and knife after handling, and keep it away from ready-to-eat food. Check the thickest piece reaches 165°F (74°C) with a thermometer; color alone is not a reliable sign.

steps.instruction: In a small skillet, bring the soy sauce, mirin, sugar and 1/2 cup water to a simmer. Add the onion and cook 3 minutes.
success_cues: Onion has softened and turned translucent

steps.instruction: Add the chicken in a single layer, cover and simmer 6 to 8 minutes, turning once.
success_cues: A thermometer in the largest piece reads 165°F (74°C)
warnings: Raw chicken: wash hands, board and knife after handling, and keep it away from ready-to-eat food. Check the thickest piece reaches 165°F (74°C) with a thermometer; color alone is not a reliable sign.
steps.creator_note: Small pieces cook evenly, so cut them all about the same size.

steps.instruction: Pour the beaten egg in a slow circle over everything. Cover and cook on low for 1 to 2 minutes, until the egg is mostly set but still soft on top.
success_cues: Egg is set at the edges and soft and glossy in the center
warnings: Soft-set egg is not fully cooked; cook it longer until firm if you are serving young children, pregnant guests or anyone who avoids runny eggs.

steps.instruction: Slide half the chicken and egg over each bowl of hot rice, spoon over the broth and top with scallion if using.
success_cues: Rice is moistened by the broth but not swimming in it

creator_notes: A small skillet makes the egg set evenly; cook in two batches if you only have a big one.
dietary_warnings: Contains egg, soy and wheat (soy sauce).
